product_one_liner.value: Disprz is an AI-powered enterprise learning and skilling platform that helps HR and L&D teams onboard, train, upskill, and develop their workforce.

hq_location.notes: West Orange is listed as headquarters by the company profile and as North America HQ by Disprz; Disprz also identifies Chennai as its Corporate & Technology HQ.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is focused on L&D, product and marketing content; the detailed Turo workflow article is by Debashree Patnaik, whose bio identifies her as Product and Content Marketing Manager, not an engineer. No qualifying engineering blog with two engineer-authored build posts was found.

public_docs.notes: Public knowledge-base material includes implementation resources, infrastructure documentation and security FAQs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current jobs board lists no qualifying AI/ML/data-science role. The AI Engineer posting explicitly says it is no longer accepting applications. The AI Content Operations Intern role concerns educational content production, not AI/ML or data-science work.

model_provider.notes: Microsoft explicitly describes Disprz using Azure OpenAI for learning personalisation.

compliance_certs.notes: The public security FAQ claims ISO 27001 certification, SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2 certification, and GDPR compliance; it says PCI DSS and HIPAA are not applicable. These are public claims, not independent verification of certification validity.

last_funding.notes: Company announcement dated 7 August 2023. A September 2025 article about a bridge between Series B and C repeats the January 2023 bridge-round news; it is not evidence of a new 2025 round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is August 2023, before the 2025-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current readable jobs board lists no qualifying SDR, BDR or account executive title. Located BDR postings explicitly say they are no longer accepting applications; AD Sales and presales roles do not meet the requested title criteria.

launched_6mo.notes: Disprz announced Autonomous Enablement OS on 2026-09-28, inside the 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window, including autonomous onboarding, sales enablement/coaching and talent development.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Anand Venkatesan joined as Senior Vice President & Head of Engineering in March 2026, within the 2025-11-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The renewal-operations posting names HubSpot/Salesforce for maintaining CRM data; the BDR posting names HubSpot, Clay, HeyReach and Lusha as sales tools.
